candidates.name: Phototoxic Maculopathy
support_spans: high-intensity LED light (30 chip-on-board LEDs emitting 5 W, 100 lm/W at 500 mA) at her right eye multiple times at very short distance with flash mode
Hyperreflective area at external retinal layers, disruption of ellipsoid zone, outer segment photoreceptor and interdigitation zone
candidates.why: The patient's symptoms and imaging findings are consistent with phototoxic maculopathy, which is a known complication of high-intensity light exposure.

candidates.name: Solar Retinopathy
support_spans: high-intensity LED light (30 chip-on-board LEDs emitting 5 W, 100 lm/W at 500 mA) at her right eye multiple times at very short distance with flash mode

candidates.why: The patient's presentation and imaging findings are similar to those seen in solar retinopathy, which can result from direct exposure to high-intensity light.
